{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: revenue = 999999.99
test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Filter out test orders and refunded orders
df_filtered = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Compute total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = df_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

total_revenue"}
